prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production original pixel art RPG transformation sprite sheet of the reference bald muscular martial monk: tan skin, stern clean-shaven face, thick large black prayer beads necklace, one black iron shoulder guard, leather diagonal chest strap, black spiral tattoo upper arm, paired spiked iron fist gauntlets with short dangling chains, dark loose pants, ragged burgundy waist cloth, tan shin wraps and bare toes. No handheld weapons. True transparent PNG background, absolutely no checkerboard, text or grid lines. Precisely FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve independent whole-body sprites. Consistent human anatomy: exactly two arms and two legs per sprite. Same body size, same baseline in cells, generous clear transparent gutter on ALL cell boundaries. Row1 four distinct walking cycle steps. Row2 four punch-combo phases: windup guard, straight punch with short blue-white crescent fist trail, follow-through punch, return guard. Keep effects COMPACT and contained in each cell, NEVER cross into neighboring cell. Row3 two ki-channeling spell poses with modest blue aura, then two hit recoil/recovery poses. No large ground ring, no debris obscuring bare feet, no repeated identical poses, no chibi style. Detailed crisp dark-outline pixel art readable at 48px, slight top-down orthographic camera. Subject identity/clothing from reference, not background or text. Every single pose must keep requested direction, especially cast/hit; do NOT turn front in rear-view sheet. All 12 sprites front three-quarter facing screen bottom.
